# Copilot Instructions

- Read `docs/PROJECT.md`, `docs/TASKS.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `docs/DECISIONS.md` before large changes.
- Keep output concise and implementation-focused.
- Prefer targeted edits and reusable abstractions.
- Use `distill` for large logs and diffs when exact raw output is unnecessary.
- Validate meaningful changes before you stop.
